# Foundations Soil

A TerraFirmaCraft expansion with persistent living-soil cells, amendments, and field records.

**Version: `0.1.0-beta` for Minecraft 1.21.1.** This beta combines the R7/R8, 0.0.4a, 0.0.5a, 0.0.6a and 0.0.7a implementation packages. Intermediate versions were not separately released. It is not a final 1.0 or a claim that manual game testing is complete.

## Included in this beta

- Scrollable Field Guide details, bounded server paging, and GUI field creation, renaming, deletion, assignment, notes and favorites.
- Persistent sand/silt/clay composition; climate-informed initial profiles; derived drainage, water-holding, aeration and root-zone response.
- A craftable Soil Laboratory with two comparison panes, complete-field snapshot analysis and up to 16 observed trend points per monitored cell.
- TFC maturity/picking-history fixes, a configurable newly-earned-yield response, and API contract 3 physical snapshots and abstract tolerance inputs.
- Protocol 8 input bounds, cooldown/replay controls, stricter persistence validation, and protection against replacing unreadable saved data with an empty record.
- Existing seven soil statistics, TFC-calendar simulation, crop rotation, residue, solid/liquid amendments, delayed releases and integration gateways remain available.

TFC owns calendar, climate, hydration, crop growth/expiry and stored N/P/K. Soil does not implement fluid transport or genetics. The yield bridge modifies only positive newly accumulated yield and can be disabled with `crop_response.tfc_yield_response_strength=0.0`.

## Requirements

| Component | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Minecraft / Java | 1.21.1 / Java 21 |
| NeoForge | Pinned to 21.1.250 |
| TerraFirmaCraft | Build pinned to file 8831715 (4.2.10); metadata minimum 4.2.8 |
| Patchouli | Build pinned to 1.21.1-92-NEOFORGE; required by TFC |
| Foundations Framework | Genuine compatible 1.21.1 build, metadata minimum 0.0.5a |

Other dependency versions require separate runtime validation. Framework remains required; it is not bundled or replaced with a stub.

## Upgrade safely

**Back up the entire world before upgrading.** Soil Cell schema/model change from 3/3 to 4/4; Field Ledger schema changes from 4 to 5; network protocol changes from 7 to 8. Use matching client/server beta JARs. Do not downgrade an upgraded world: restore the backup instead.

If saved data cannot be read, the guard refuses an empty replacement. Stop the server and repair or restore the original file rather than deleting it to silence the error.

## Build and verification

```sh
./gradlew --no-daemon clean test build soilScaleBenchmark
```

Windows users can use `gradlew.bat` with the same arguments. Outputs include `build/libs/foundations_soil-1.21.1-0.1.0-beta.jar` and the sources JAR. Benchmark output is `build/reports/soil-scale-benchmark.json`.

The standalone model suite contains **70 passing tests** against the actual pinned dependency classpath. Tests cover migration, persistence, ownership, packets, resources and exact TFC hook targets. The GitHub release pipeline reruns native Gradle compilation, tests and the benchmark before publishing. These results are not evidence of a full game launch or live-server TPS.

Full mod-loading tests are a separate mode:

```sh
./gradlew --no-daemon -PmodRuntimeTests=true clean test
```

This requires the genuine Framework JAR at the configured `libs/<framework_jar>` path. Client/dedicated-server launches, in-game Mixin transformation, GUI-scale checks, real-world upgrades, seasonal balance and optional-integration pack tests remain open. See [the validation matrix](docs/beta/VALIDATION.md).

## Platform and release policy

Retain 1.21.1 while developing the newer 26.3 line separately; move that newer line to 26.4 when released and compatible dependencies are validated. **This beta is 1.21.1 only; the Soil 26.3 port is pending.** Every platform release must publish its own built JAR and source on GitHub Releases. This beta uses tag `mc-1.21.1-v0.1.0-beta` and is a prerelease, not a stable/latest release.

# Foundations Soil - 0.1.0-beta delivery status

Baseline: 0.0.3a.R6. The intervening implementation packages are combined into **0.1.0-beta**; no intermediate releases are invented. A feature implementation is not the same as completed in-game acceptance.

| Package | Implemented in this beta | Remaining acceptance |

| R8 | Create/rename/delete fields, assign cells, notes/favorites, ownership checks and server acknowledgement | Two-player editing, reconnect and rejection behavior |
| 0.0.4a and revisions | Persistent normalized texture, climate initialization and derived root-zone physics; old seven stats preserved | Seasonal balance and real old-world upgrade trials |

## Executed automated evidence

The actual Java 21 dependency classpath compiles the source; **70 tests pass with zero skips or failures**. The 1k/10k/50k model/storage benchmark preserves all cell tags through compressed save/load. The native release workflow repeats Gradle compilation/tests and the benchmark before committing/publishing the combined implementation.

Model tests do not start the full modpack. Target-bytecode tests do not prove successful in-game Mixin transformation. Benchmark numbers are not live-server TPS. See [VALIDATION.md](docs/beta/VALIDATION.md) for the precise evidence and unexecuted matrix.

## Open beta gates

- [ ] Supported integrated and dedicated TFC/Framework instances launch and `/fsoil selftest` passes.
- [ ] Real old-world copies migrate without resetting soil, fields, notes or delayed amendments.
- [ ] GUI scales, long text, paging and edit confirmations pass manual testing.
- [ ] Two-player ownership, spoof/replay rejection, reconnect and matching protocol pass live testing.
- [ ] TFC crop/yield trials, picking, automation, expiry and reload pass the compatibility matrix.
- [ ] Multi-season timing, accelerated days and restarts during delayed releases preserve intended outcomes.
- [ ] Production-scale chunk sampling, saves, heap and packets are profiled.
- [ ] Native KubeJS/Genetics/JEI/Jade and fluid-delivery pack tests pass.
- [ ] Separate 26.3 source port and compatible dependencies compile and launch before a 26.x release.

Schema/model are now 4/4, Field Ledger schema 5, protocol 8 and API contract 3. Back up worlds; downgrades require restoring the backup. Erosion, groundwater, deep horizons and irrigation transport remain later expansions, not hidden beta deliverables.

# Current delivery note - 0.1.0-beta

The R7/R8 and 0.0.4a through 0.0.7a implementation packages are now combined in 0.1.0-beta for 1.21.1. The detailed roadmap below is retained as historical planning, not a current checklist of absent code. Consult [ROADMAP_0.1.md](ROADMAP_0.1.md) and [the beta validation matrix](docs/beta/VALIDATION.md) for implemented work versus remaining acceptance. # 0.1.0-beta - 2026-10-08 Pacific

Combined R7/R8, physical-soil, Laboratory, integration and hardening implementations. Added full Field Guide scrolling and GUI edits; persistent texture and root-zone physics; craftable comparison Laboratory and bounded trends; maturity/picking fixes and configurable TFC yield-delta response; API contract 3; protocol 8 request bounds and replay controls; strict persistence and an unreadable-save replacement guard. Repaired Java/Parchment build properties, added reproducible source/binary packaging, 70 automated tests and 1k/10k/50k model/storage benchmarks.

**Back up worlds:** Soil schema/model 4/4, ledger schema 5, network 8. Runtime pack and manual beta acceptance remain pending. Intermediate milestone numbers were not separately released. See [full release notes](docs/beta/RELEASE_NOTES.md).

---

# 0.1.0-beta configuration additions

```toml
[crop_response]
tfc_yield_response_strength = 0.5
```

Range 0.0-1.0. Zero disables Soil's yield adjustment; one applies the full response to newly accumulated TFC yield. Previous yield, crop growth/expiry, stored N/P/K and TFC hydration are not rewritten. The default is a gameplay balance value requiring seasonal pack testing.

Protocol 8 applies hard per-message caps of 64 cells, 128 fields and eight event rows per cell even when historical settings below permit larger limits. Paging provides access to additional records. A monitored cell keeps at most 16 observed TFC-day trend endpoints; gaps are not fabricated. Input text limits are 64 characters for field names and 256 for notes. The existing seven-stat and time-scale configuration remains available below.

# 0.1.0-beta integration - 2026-10-08 Pacific / 2026-10-09 UTC

Implemented the intervening roadmap packages in one beta source change. Local Java 21 compilation and 70 standalone automated tests passed against the genuine pinned dependency classpath; 1k/10k/50k compressed cell round trips passed. The native GitHub build/release gate repeats compile/test/benchmark before publication. These are model/storage results, not a successful full-modpack launch.

The genuine Framework Library record could not be materialized for this runtime. Framework remains a hard dependency; no stub or optional fallback was introduced. In-game Mixin transformation, crop balance, UI, multiplayer, actual world migration and optional-integration acceptance remain explicitly open in [VALIDATION.md](docs/beta/VALIDATION.md). The 26.3 port is not claimed as delivered.

# Beta Field Guide and Laboratory workflow

In 0.1.0-beta, use **New field** to create a plot. Select a discovered cell and **Edit** to assign its field, note and favorite. Select a field and Edit to rename it or change notes/favorites. Deletion requires confirmation and preserves discovered cells and their notes. Every edit is applied to the authenticated player's ledger and displayed only after server acknowledgement.

The right detail pane wraps and scrolls independently with the mouse wheel, scroll thumb, Page Up/Down and Home/End. Search applies to the current server page; use paging arrows for further records. A field summary drawn from a partial guide page is labeled as a subset. The craftable **Soil Laboratory** compares two own-cell or own-field records and uses every field member for its snapshot averages without loading distant chunks. TFC probe timestamps, soil-update times and observed trend gaps remain explicit.

The command reference below remains available. Manual GUI-scale and multiplayer acceptance is still pending.

# Current Soil API contract: 3

0.1.0-beta adds immutable physical snapshots and abstract tolerance-based soil responses while preserving existing Java/service helpers. See [API contract 3](docs/beta/INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md) for authoritative usage and boundaries. The earlier contract below remains historical reference, not a claim of a native KubeJS plugin or completed Genetics/Cannabis integration. Actual adapter/pack testing remains required; Soil does not store genomes or replace TFC water and nutrients.
